The candidate must be able to frame complex problems as modeling problems, execute rigorous research cycles, and deliver reproducible solutions that can be integrated by engineering teams. This role operates in close collaboration with an ML Engineering team. The candidate is expected to have clear judgment about their responsibilities within that ecosystem and the discipline to work with software engineering standards, not just analysis standards. Requisitos What We Are Looking For Technical Fundamentals Advanced mastery of Python as the primary and sole development language. Solid knowledge of data science and ML libraries: Scikit-Learn , XGBoost , LightGBM , Pandas , Polars , Statsmodels , SciPy . Experience with deep learning models ( TensorFlow or PyTorch ) when the problem justifies it. Ability to work with data at scale: advanced SQL, PySpark for exploration and transformation. Access to and handling of data in cloud environments (GCS, Azure Blob Storage). Statistical Rigor Experimental design and hypothesis testing applied to business problems. Understanding of causality: not just correlation but the ability to distinguish and apply appropriate techniques. Robust model validation: beyond accuracy, business metrics, bias analysis, and subgroup behavior. Development Discipline Professional use of Git as part of the usual workflow, not as a formality at delivery time. Organized and modular Python code: the candidate must produce deliverable code, not just exploration notebooks. Familiarity with experiment tracking tools (MLflow or equivalent) for experiment traceability. Ability to document models in a structured way: what it solves, with what data, with what limitations. Experience working under team standards: secure credential handling, data versioning, project structure. Judgment on AI Responsible use of generative AI tools as assistants: with the critical ability to review and validate what they produce. Judgment to evaluate when agent systems or LLMs are the right tool and when they are not. Recommended Experience Notes for the Search The selection process includes a practical technical evaluation and review of the candidate’s previous work. Reasoning ability and judgment will be valued over code production speed. We are not looking for profiles who use tools without understanding them: we are looking for candidates who can justify their technical and statistical decisions. The candidate will work under engineering standards defined by the team — willingness and ability to adopt them from the start of any project is expected. More than 5 years in data science, statistical analysis, or applied research roles. Documentable end-to-end projects: from problem definition to delivery of a validated model. Experience working with engineering teams (ML Engineers, Data Engineers) in agile environments. Work history in real code repositories (a shareable portfolio will be valued). Academic Background Master’s or Doctoral degree in: Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Physics, Computer Science, or related fields. Title: EQS Data and AI Analyst
Description: A Snapshot of Your Day Your day starts by reviewing global EQS data flows and signals—not just to report what happened, but to understand what might happen next . You begin by validating automated data pipelines and Power BI semantic models, ensuring data accuracy across Safety, Environmental, and Sustainability domains. From there, you shift into AI‑driven analytics, refining predictive models, experimenting with new features, and validating outputs against real-world EQS scenarios. Midday, you collaborate with stakeholders across Business Areas and IT to translate evolving EQS needs into scalable solutions. This could include designing a RAG‑enabled assistant to support reporting queries, enhancing anomaly detection models, or automating manual reporting processes using AI and advanced analytics. You continuously evaluate where AI can reduce effort, increase insight quality, and strengthen risk visibility. Throughout the day, you balance hands‑on development with strategic thinking—ensuring that everything you build is reusable, governed, and aligned to enterprise standards. You close your day by sharing knowledge—whether refining documentation, enabling colleagues through training, or shaping the next generation of EQS analytics capabilities. How You’ll Make An Impact You will play a key role in transforming EQS reporting from descriptive to predictive and intelligence‑driven. By embedding AI into our analytics ecosystem, you will help the organization move beyond historical reporting toward forward‑looking insights that support proactive risk management and decision‑making. Your work will improve the speed, quality, and scalability of EQS reporting—reducing manual effort, strengthening audit readiness, and enabling consistent global insights. You will also act as a technical reference point, elevating the capability of the entire team by introducing modern analytics approaches, reusable standards, and AI‑enabled solutions. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, Environmental Sciences, or a related field. Strong experience in data analytics, reporting, digital transformation, or business intelligence roles. Experience working with analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and large, structured datasets. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Effective communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across global teams. Experience in EHS, Quality, Security, sustainability, or non-financial reporting environments is an advantage. Note: You bring deep expertise at the intersection of Power BI, AI, and data engineering, with the ability to design and deliver enterprise‑grade analytics solutions. You are comfortable working across the full data lifecycle—from pipeline design and semantic modeling to advanced AI applications such as machine learning models, LLMs, RAG architectures, and prompt engineering. Beyond technical capability, you bring strong judgment. You understand when AI adds value—and when it doesn’t. You can translate complex EQS and business needs into meaningful analytics, challenge assumptions constructively, and design solutions that are both scalable and practical. You communicate confidently, think critically, and naturally enable others by sharing knowledge, defining standards, and building reusable assets. About The Team You will join a global EQS Reporting team operating at the intersection of Environment, Health, Safety, Quality, and Security. The team is highly collaborative and works closely with Business Areas, IT, and Corporate Functions to deliver reliable, compliant, and forward‑looking reporting. As the function continues to evolve, the team is increasingly focused on digitalization and AI‑enabled reporting, with initiatives such as analytics automation, data product development, and AI‑powered insights shaping the roadmap. You will play a key role in this transformation—helping to define how EQS data is leveraged at scale and how advanced analytics becomes a core capability across the organization. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With ~100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Formada a partir de la fusión de IMS Health y Quintiles, IQVIA ofrece una amplia gama de soluciones que aprovechan los avances en información, tecnología, análisis e ingenio humano para impulsar la atención médica. Actualmente nos encontramos en la búsqueda de profesionales interesados en ser parte de un gran proyecto con un importante socio de negocios. Analista de Datos para Programas de Soporte a Pacientes Acerca de la posición Estamos en búsqueda de un(a) Analista de Datos de Programas con sólida experiencia en análisis de información, inteligencia de negocio y generación de insights estratégicos. Esta posición tendrá un rol fundamental en la administración y explotación de datos del programa, contribuyendo a la toma de decisiones mediante la generación de reportes, seguimiento de indicadores clave y desarrollo de análisis orientados a la mejora continua del negocio. La persona seleccionada colaborará con equipos multidisciplinarios para garantizar la calidad, disponibilidad y correcta interpretación de la información, así como para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y optimización basadas en datos. Responsabilidades Actualizar, administrar y optimizar dashboards y reportes en Power BI. Participar en la implementación, mantenimiento y evolución de herramientas CRM. Generar análisis de negocio que permitan identificar tendencias, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora. Elaborar reportes ejecutivos y presentar insights relevantes a stakeholders internos. Realizar el seguimiento y monitoreo de KPIs definidos para equipos operativos y comerciales. Colaborar en la gestión y estructuración de bases de datos provenientes de diversas fuentes. Apoyar la administración de información relacionada con canales digitales y asignaciones territoriales. Brindar soporte a usuarios internos en temas relacionados con dashboards, reportes y análisis de datos. Gestionar y dar seguimiento a incidencias o requerimientos relacionados con la información del programa. Capacitar y acompañar a usuarios en la interpretación y uso de herramientas de análisis. Documentar procesos, metodologías, fuentes de información y actualizaciones relacionadas con la gestión de datos. Garantizar la calidad, consistencia e integridad de la información utilizada por el programa. Formación académica Licenciatura concluida en Economía, Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Actuaría, Ciencias de Datos o áreas afines. Experiencia Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, business analytics, inteligencia de negocio o gestión de información. Conocimientos técnicos indispensables Dominio de Power BI (modelado de datos, desarrollo de dashboards y reporting). Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel y Microsoft Office. Experiencia trabajando con CRM y bases de datos. Conocimiento en definición, cálculo y seguimiento de KPIs. Experiencia en elaboración de reportes ejecutivos y visualización de datos + la presentación de los mismos a personas claves de la unidad de negocio. Competencias Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados. Capacidad para identificar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades de negocio. Habilidad para transformar hallazgos analíticos en recomendaciones accionables. Excelente comunicación escrita y verbal. Organización y atención al detalle. Enfoque en calidad de datos y mejora continua. Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y colaborar con diferentes áreas de la organización. Orientación al servicio y atención a usuarios internos. Idiomas Inglés avanzado. Lo que ofrecemos Oportunidad de participar en proyectos estratégicos de alto impacto. Exposición a equipos multidisciplinarios y tomadores de decisión. Desarrollo profesional en un entorno dinámico orientado a datos. Prestaciones superiores a las de ley. Ubicación: Ciudad de México. Si te apasiona el análisis de datos, la generación de insights y la mejora continua basada en información estratégica, nos encantaría conocerte. IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

This role includes collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, user support, and the documentation of processes related to data management.
TechStack: Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office, CRM systems, Data analytics, KPI tracking, Business analytics
